original_target.title: Anderson localization for the cosine skew-shift model at every coupling

scope_comparison: Wang–Peng–Piao's latest primary theorem requires sufficiently large coupling and proves Lyapunov exponent positivity/continuity. The target requires exponential point spectrum for every positive coupling and each Diophantine alpha in the cosine skew-shift model. Long-range dynamical estimates and quasiperiodic rather than skew-shift results do not establish it.
